evaluation.timing_order_interpretation: The candidate ran before the comparator after only a label-free generic warm-up, so public-workload warming cannot favor the candidate.

strategy.name: exact_value_orchestration

ordinary_actions.search: Recompute whenever any retrieval or Stage-A ranking dependency changes.
ordinary_actions.reuse: Reuse only a complete successful pre-slate ranking after exact dependency and backend-snapshot identity equality.
ordinary_actions.skip: Skip retrieval only when the requested result count is empty.

strategy.ask_and_recommend: Clarification remains independent of retrieval. The agent still recommends on every ordinary turn and asks an unresolved question when allowed; there is no accuracy-reducing ask-only branch.
strategy.confidence: Intent completeness is bounded evidence telemetry, not a calibrated probability and not a threshold for suppressing a changed search.
exact_dependency_inputs: ordered active requirement value, source, and attribute
immutable backend capability and snapshot identity
strategy.ranking_and_slate_separation: Turn, question history, requirement turn, intent version, and positive top-k do not affect the full ranking. Intent version and top-k remain in the slate signature, so overrides and window-size changes still reset presentation history.
strategy.backend_safety: Only the built-in immutable-complete-fused-ranking-v1 capability with the exact payload-free token type can reuse. Unknown, mutable, stateful, top-k-dependent, or partial backends fail closed to SEARCH.

cache_bounds.retained_fields: dependency digest, payload-free snapshot identity, and product IDs only
cache_bounds.forbidden_fields: messages, query text, requirements, profiles, documents, vectors, scores, questions, responses, and slate state

strategy.failure_policy: Fallbacks, route faults, retrieval exceptions, incomplete documents, reranker skips/failures, empty rankings, and malformed entries are never cached. Reset and backend identity changes invalidate safely.

equivalence.interpretation: Phase 7 changes computation scheduling only; every externally relevant Phase 6 decision remains exact.

limitations.quality_change: This phase deliberately preserves quality rather than tuning public labels. It improves speed, memory discipline, and failure isolation without changing ranking or clarification behavior.
limitations.confidence_calibration: Intent completeness remains an interpretable evidence proxy, not a probability of target success.
limitations.cache_scope: Reuse is enabled only for a backend that explicitly guarantees deterministic immutable complete fused rankings.
